Polaris 1.7.0 and Gravitino 1.1.0 are deliberate evidence baselines, not assertions of the latest release.

Databricks scope covers AWS documentation only; do not generalize to every cloud, region or subscription tier.
All claims remain draft and documentation-based. Full means the narrowly qualified contract is documented, not runtime-tested or production-certified.
Missing claims remain unknown. Coverage is property-level inventory, not exhaustive combinations or product completeness.
Sources are linked and sections identified; full upstream page snapshots are not archived in this revision.
Repeated use of one URL is not independent confirmation. No scores, rankings or hidden negative defaults are added.
Documentation ambiguities are tracked in layer-1-research-notes.md; affected strict capability claims remain unknown.
